Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns. 
Damaged items:
• Report the issue within 7 days of delivery.
• Send photos of the damaged item and the packaging/packing slip.
• Keep the item in the condition you received it.
• The photos help verify what happened and allow the case to be reviewed for a possible resolution. 
Normal returns:
• Returns are not accepted after delivery if it’s simply a change of mind or taste.
• Alcohol purchases also cannot be returned due to state regulations. 
So if something arrives damaged, the key step is reporting it quickly and providing photos, rather than sending it back as a standard return.
